messages:
deploy-bot: CI pipeline <https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5523|#5523> finished and created image redwood/api:canary-20240328-5523 (sha256:aaa111)

mike: seeing a spike in 5xx on canary pods, 50% of requests failing. alerting oncall.

jen: on it, looking at logs now. can anyone confirm which cluster region this canary rolled to? aws-eu-central-1

sara: canary rollout initiated by release job `release/canary` at 11:04 UTC. image tag matches the pipeline output: redwood/api:canary-20240328-5523

mike: top-level error from pods:
```
panic: load plugin: open /app/plugins/libplugin.so: no such file or directory
stack: ...
```

lee: that looks like a missing build artifact. CI sometimes caches a stale layer with old /plugins directory. previous successful build 5522 used sha256:bbb222 and had the plugin. 5523 seems to have dropped it.

carlos: confirming: `docker history` for both digests shows layer diff. 5523 base layer omitted the /app/plugins addition step. possible cache miss or context path wrong in Dockerfile.

mike: immediate mitigation: disable canary via rollout pause and toggle feature flag for new-plugin onprod

jen: applying both: `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/api-canary` -> paused

sara: toggling FF: /ops/flags/new-plugin -> false (via admin console)

oncall-rotation-bot: @mike, you have been paged for 30m handover window. Please ack.

mike: acked. will coordinate handover after mitigation.

lee: rolling back to previous replicaset: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-canary --to-revision=2` (that maps to image redwood/api:canary-20240328-5522 sha256:bbb222)

jen: rollback started. monitoring logs/metrics.

mike: customers: small set of sessions in EU saw errors (rate ~3% of total traffic for a short window). Post-rollback error-rate trending down to baseline.

carlos: CI side investigation: pipeline step `build:copy-plugins` is conditional on cache hit; the build matrix changed the context directory in the new job variant, causing the step to be skipped. patch incoming.

sara: created hotfix branch and triggered a rebuild with forced cache-bust turned off, new build #5524 producing redwood/api:canary-20240328-5524 sha256:ccc333. Diff shows plugin layer present.

jen: we should NOT re-roll canary until we confirm registry immutability and that the tag-to-digest mapping is correct.

mike: agreed. leave canary paused and FF off. status page update: setting "Degraded — partial error rate in EU during canary rollout; rollback applied; mitigation in progress". I'll post an update to customers in ~15m.

lee: steps for postmortem:
- revert conditional context change in pipeline
- add explicit step to verify file list inside built image (eg `docker run --rm image tar -tf /app/plugins`)
- disallow ephemeral caching for critical layers in canary builds
- add alert on image-digest drift between expected and pushed

carlos: also adding a CI check that validates expected files present and bakes a file_manifest artifact in the build job.

mike: handing off to night oncall @sara in 25m. sara, please take over and if error-rate remains low and verification passes, we can mark incident as resolved and unpause canary later with stricter gating.

sara: taking it. I'll keep the flag false and the deployment paused until we have green verification from CI and a signed-off new canary run.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: mike -> sara. Next rotation: 2024-03-29 07:00 UTC.

jen: filing an incident ticket: INC-2024-081, linking CI build 5523, images (aaa111/ bbb222/ ccc333), timeline, and impacted customers. tagging postmortem owners: lee + carlos.

mike: thanks everyone. quick note for follow-up: add a runbook snippet for "stale-layer canary failure" showing commands used and timelines.

sara: will do. closing this thread once incident ticket created and status page updated.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket INC-2024-081 created and linked to thread. Final status: rollback applied, canary paused, feature flag disabled, rebuild in progress.
